title: An untouched log on release day shows its empty state
custom_preconds:
Setup file (for Claude sessions; a tester does not need it)

Preconditions

  • You are signed in as a user with the "Admin" role, working in {Location-A}.
    For example: {Location-A} is Staging Heavy Duty - 9919.
  • The organization existed before the release and nobody has used the Credit Terms page since.
  • Starting screen: the Credit Terms page (Settings, then "Credit Terms" in the Finance group) is open on the Active tab.
  • If any record above is missing, mark this test Blocked: "setup not done".
custom_steps:
1. Click the "⋯" page menu beside "New Credit Term".
  2. Click "Audit Log".
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • Step 1: the menu opens.
  • Step 2: the table has no rows and shows "No history here. Yet." (changes from before the release are not in the log).

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "Credit terms", Confluence 963346440, version 3 (22 Oct 2026, "Renamed to Credit terms", Chris Ward), read 23 Oct 2026 · Epic SV-11638, story SV-11681 (Story 12, Credit Terms audit log)

  • S12-E1: “When the log has no rows, the table shows the log's standard empty state, "No history here. Yet."”
  • S12-N2: “Changes made before release are not in the log; it starts empty on release day.”
  • User Feedback Summary: “Credit Terms Log has no rows | "No history here. Yet." | Empty state in the table”
